inlines.v: HIND, noun The female of the red deer or stag. HIND, noun A domestic; a servant. 1. A peasant; a rustic; or a husbandman's servant. HIND, adjective Backward; pertaining to the part which follows; in opposition to the fore part; as the hind legs of a quadruped; the hind toes; the hind shoes of a horse; the hind part of an animal.
